## Still open

No open layout, novice-copy, or Cloud Run CI/CD items from this pass.

### Params chip said search radius instead of Search circle (resolved)

**Where:** desktop `#paramsBar` `search radius` chip; Map overlays Search circle (start / current) tooltips.

**Problem:** After Match / Grid / grid cell / saved Match landed, the radius chip still said `search radius` while Map overlays said `Search circle`. Circle tooltips also claimed the size was “from Grid”, so skip-tour users could not map the chip number to the purple/pink overlays.

**Fix:** Chip reads `circle radius` with a Search circle tooltip. Overlay titles say the size matches the circle radius chip. Fixture `scrollWidth` stays within 900.

**Evidence:**

- Before/after fixture: `web/usability/circle-radius-search-circle.html`
- Fixture screenshot (900px): `web/usability/circle-radius-search-circle.png`

content.text: The fixture check failed because `innerText` omits `title` attributes — I'll fix that assertion.

input.new_string:
<script>
    const before = document.getElementById("before").innerText;
    const after = document.getElementById("after").innerText;
    const beforeTips = [...document.querySelectorAll("#before [title]")].map((el) => el.title).join(" ");
    const chipTip = document.getElementById("circleChip").title;
    const startTip = document.getElementById("startTip").title;
    const currTip = document.getElementById("currTip").title;
    const hasCircle = after.includes("circle radius") && !after.includes("search radius");
    const beforeOld = before.includes("search radius") && beforeTips.includes("radius from Grid");
    const tipOk = chipTip.includes("Search circle")
      && startTip.includes("circle radius chip")
      && currTip.includes("circle radius chip")
      && !startTip.includes("radius from Grid")
      && !currTip.includes("radius from Grid");
    const scroll = document.documentElement.scrollWidth;
    const ok = beforeOld && hasCircle && tipOk && scroll <= 900;
    document.getElementById("check").textContent =
      `ok=${ok} scrollWidth=${scroll} beforeOld=${beforeOld} circle=${hasCircle} tipOk=${tipOk}`;
  </script>
